(Except to Co-op members) |auctionable = no |soulbound=Co-op }} The '''Ephemeral Gratitude''' is an {{Uncommon}} item. == Obtaining == === Garden Visitors === An '''Ephemeral Gratitude''' is obtained by accepting a [[The Garden#Visitors|Visitor]] offer in {{zone|The Garden}} within 2 seconds of the Visitor spawning. Once this is done, the following dialogue is displayed: {{Dialogue| &b&lTHANKFUL! &7You received an &aEphemeral Gratitude &7for accepting &7a commission so quickly! }} == Usage == === Shop Purchase === {{Item|Ephemeral Gratitude|amount=2}} can be given to the {{NPCSprite|Tyashoi Alchemist}} in exchange for an {{Item|Eerie Pet}}. This can only be done once during each Alchemy experiment. == Tips == *In order to accept visitor offers so quickly, keep materials in an [[Agronomy Sack]] and [[Enchanted Agronomy Sack]]. *Visitors spawn between {{Green|15}} and {{Green|12}} minutes, depending on milestones. ** Visitor spawning can be sped up by farming crops. *Waiting where a visitor spawns allows for quick access. ** If the waiting queue is full, visitors will spawn at the end of the queue. *Clicking the visitor twice allows you to skip their dialogue. *You can use a Bachelor's Rose on two low-rarity visitors to ensure you buy the right items. == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|2023/October 24|[[File:Ephemeral Gratitude.png|26px]] Added '''Ephemeral Gratitude'''.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Great Spook}}
